title: Chromatic polynomial of the wheel
statement:
Let $n \ge 3$ and $k \ge 1$ be integers, and let $W_n = C_n \vee K_1$ be the wheel with $n$ spokes, obtained from the cycle $C_n$ on $n$ vertices by adjoining a single hub vertex joined to every vertex of the cycle. Writing $\pi_k(W_n)$ for the number of distinct proper $k$-colourings of $W_n$, one has
\[ \pi_k(W_n) = k(k-2)^n + (-1)^n\, k(k-2). \]
